cards.title: Congress: one sign for four drawings

options.change: Dome, cupola and finial become a flat top; the columns become walls, windows and a center door, which takes the red.

naming_cd.creative_director_reading: A city hall or a museum; with the label, a Capitol without its dome

options.naming_maker: A large public building, most likely a city hall or a museum. Recognized with the label

options.change: The chamber in session from the gallery: five members on the near bench seen from behind, a far bench in five sections, and the three-tier rostrum with its top tier red.

naming_cd.creative_director_reading: An assembly on a curved bench facing a stepped rostrum
naming_cd.creative_director_verdict: Names it nearly; the label makes it the House at once

options.naming_maker: An assembly: members on a curved bench facing a stepped rostrum; with the label, the House in session. Names it nearly

options.change: The chamber from the rostrum: members face the reader from two curved benches, and the presiding desk stands red in the foreground.

naming_cd.creative_director_reading: Members in two tiers facing a red table: an assembly, or an audience

options.naming_maker: Members in two tiers facing a presiding desk: an assembly, or an audience. Recognized with the label

options.change: Spire, cupola and dome become set A's flat top; the six columns become two walls. The fence and the red door stay.

naming_cd.creative_director_reading: A government building behind a fence, or a compound

options.naming_maker: A government building fenced in. Names it nearly

options.change: Set B's chamber in session without the Speaker's tier, inside a fence opened up so it reads at 48 px; the red moves from the door to the rostrum's top tier.

naming_cd.creative_director_reading: A chamber of members closed in by a fence

options.naming_maker: A chamber of members closed in by a fence. Names it nearly

options.change: A ballot's arrow runs at the fenced chamber and stops on a red bar at the fence, to show that an election cannot move the body.

naming_cd.creative_director_reading: A ballot stopped at the fence round a chamber: a vote that cannot get in

options.naming_maker: A ballot stopped at the fence round a chamber: a vote that cannot get in. Names it nearly

options.change: The dome's arcs and its finial go, leaving the drum, the round wall the dome sat on, as a flat top; the drum columns go and the lower columns become two windows and a door.

naming_cd.creative_director_reading: Two people, a building and an open book: a library
naming_cd.creative_director_verdict: Misleads without the label (kept by DR-135)

options.naming_maker: Two people, a building and an open book; the book pulls toward reading or a library. Misleads without the label

options.change: Set B's chamber in session replaces the building, above two staff and an analyst's report whose chart line takes the red.

naming_cd.creative_director_reading: A legislature in session above two staff and a report

options.naming_maker: A legislature in session above two staff and a report: the legislature's own staff. Recognized with the label

options.change: Set C's chamber from the rostrum replaces the building, above two staff and an analyst's report whose chart line takes the red.

naming_cd.creative_director_reading: An assembly above two staff and a report

options.naming_maker: An assembly above two staff and a report. Recognized with the label

options.change: Finial, lantern and dome go, leaving the drum as a flat top; the columns become a band and windows. The ballot box, the chart and the red stay.

naming_cd.creative_director_reading: A building, a ballot box and a container: voting on shipping
naming_cd.creative_director_verdict: Misleads without the label (kept by DR-135)

options.naming_maker: A building, a ballot box and a crate with an arrow; the ballot box reads as a public election. Misleads without the label

options.change: Set B's chamber in session, a red vote card with a yes and a no in place of the ballot box, and CL-064's parcel with a tag for imports.

naming_cd.creative_director_reading: A legislature in session, a yes-and-no card and a parcel with a tag: a vote on goods

options.naming_maker: A legislature in session, a yes-and-no card and a parcel with a tag: a vote on goods. Recognized with the label

options.change: Set C's chamber from the rostrum, a red vote card with a yes and a no in place of the ballot box, and CL-064's parcel with a tag for imports.

naming_cd.creative_director_reading: An assembly, a yes-and-no card and a parcel with a tag

options.naming_maker: An assembly, a yes-and-no card and a parcel with a tag: a vote on goods. Recognized with the label

options.change: The four columns become one wall holding a round vault door. The pediment, the triangle above the columns, stays, and so do the base, the home, the factory and the red branches.

naming_cd.creative_director_reading: A bank sending money to a home and a factory
naming_cd.creative_director_verdict: Names the subject (through its temple front)

options.naming_maker: A bank, or a temple, sending money to a home and a factory. Names the subject

options.change: The pediment goes too: a flat-roofed bank with a round vault door on its face, its wheel's handles standing past the rim.

naming_cd.creative_director_reading: A bank vault with its wheel, paying out to a home and a factory

options.naming_maker: A bank vault with its wheel, paying out to a home and a factory. Names the subject

options.change: The lender and the loan: a small flat-roofed building beside a loan paper marked with a percent sign; the red branches carry the money out.

naming_cd.creative_director_reading: A lender's office and a loan paper paying out; the percent sign is small at 48 px

options.naming_maker: A lender's office and a loan paper with a percent sign, paying out to a home and a factory. Names the subject

options.change: The four groups of columns become one wall with a door and two windows. The pediment, band, base, brace and official stay.

naming_cd.creative_director_reading: A house or a school beside a speaker at a lectern

options.naming_maker: A house or a school and a speaker at a lectern, set apart by a bracket; the pediment over a door reads as a house. Recognized with the label

options.change: A flat-roofed office building with no columns or pediment, the red brace, and the official at a desk whose arrow stops at it.

naming_cd.creative_director_reading: An office building kept apart from a person at a desk whose arrow stops at the bracket

options.naming_maker: An office building kept apart from a person at a desk, whose arrow stops at the bracket. Names it nearly

options.change: The commission at its table, and the official moves to a desk; a longer arrow from the desk stops at the red brace.

naming_cd.creative_director_reading: A panel of three kept apart from a person at a desk whose arrow stops at the bracket

options.naming_maker: A panel of three kept apart from a person at a desk, whose arrow stops at the bracket. Names it nearly

options.change: A raised, curved dais with three officials above the witness, who sits at a table with a front panel and a red microphone.

naming_cd.creative_director_reading: A hearing: a witness seated at a table with a microphone, facing a raised panel

options.naming_maker: A hearing: a witness seated at a table with a microphone, facing a raised panel. Names the subject

options.change: Written testimony: a signed sheet of testimony handed up from the person to the committee's raised, curved dais, with the red on the signature.

naming_cd.creative_director_reading: A person handing a signed paper up to a panel: written testimony, or a petition

options.naming_maker: A person handing a signed paper up to a panel: written testimony, or to some a petition. Names it nearly

options.change: The raised, curved dais with three officials, and the red microphone on the witness table; the reader is the witness.

naming_cd.creative_director_reading: A panel with a microphone: a hearing, or a panel talk

options.naming_maker: A panel and a microphone: a hearing, or a panel discussion. Names it nearly

options.change: A person and an official at a desk, joined by one line that carries a red speech mark.

naming_cd.creative_director_reading: A person sending a message to someone at a desk

options.naming_maker: A person sending a message to someone at a desk. Names the subject

options.change: A simple phone whose red cord runs to an official at a desk.

naming_cd.creative_director_reading: A desk phone wired to someone at a desk: calling an office

options.naming_maker: A desk phone wired to someone at a desk: calling an office. Names the subject

options.change: In person: the person stands at the official's desk and one red speech mark rises between them.

naming_cd.creative_director_reading: A person speaking to someone at a desk: a visit, or a help desk

options.naming_maker: A person talking to someone at a desk: a visit, or a help desk. Names it nearly

cards.title: The utility family: bare actions or ringed
Close

options.shows: A bare cross
options.naming_maker: Names it: Close.

cards.fewer_reason: Readers know one sign for Close, the bare cross. The ring is a choice for the whole set, on the family card.

cards.title: Menu

options.shows: Three even bars
options.naming_maker: Names it: Menu.

options.shows: Two even bars

naming_cd.creative_director_reading: An equals sign or a drag handle alone; Menu beside its word

options.naming_maker: Partly: Alone, an equals sign or a drag handle; beside its word, Menu at once.

cards.fewer_reason: Three dots say More and a grid says apps, so no third form names Menu.

cards.title: Arrow (Next, Previous and the sort order)

options.shows: An arrow with a shaft and an open head
options.naming_maker: Names it: Next, or go forward.

options.shows: An arrow with a shaft and a closed triangle head

naming_cd.creative_director_reading: Next, with a closed head; a plug at a glance

options.naming_maker: Names it: Next, or go.

cards.fewer_reason: A longer shaft copied A too closely, and the ring is a choice for the whole set, on the family card.

cards.title: Chevron (expand and collapse)

options.shows: A chevron

naming_cd.creative_director_reading: Show more, or open the list

options.naming_maker: Names it: Show more, or open the list.

options.shows: A disclosure triangle, drawn in line

naming_cd.creative_director_reading: A dropdown caret: open the list

options.naming_maker: Names it: Open the list: the dropdown sign.

cards.fewer_reason: A smaller chevron copied A too closely, and plus and minus are the atlas's polarity signs.

options.shows: An arrow down into an open tray
options.naming_maker: Names it: Download.

options.shows: An arrow down onto a line
options.naming_maker: Names it: Download, or save.

options.shows: An arrow down on a page with a folded corner
options.naming_maker: Names it: Download the file.

cards.title: Go to another site

options.shows: An arrow leaving a box by its top right corner
options.naming_maker: Names it: Open somewhere else, or open in a new tab.

options.shows: A bare arrow up and to the right

naming_cd.creative_director_reading: Up and to the right, or trending up

options.naming_maker: Partly: Up and to the right; may read as trending up.

cards.fewer_reason: A window would say the link opens a new window, and these links open in the same tab (audit 1.2).

cards.title: Search

options.shows: A magnifier: round lens, handle to the lower right
options.naming_maker: Names it: Search.

cards.fewer_reason: Readers know one sign for Search. A glint or a larger lens copied it too closely, and the ring is on the family card.

options.shows: A funnel with a slanted spout
options.naming_maker: Names it: Filter.

options.shows: Three lines narrowing downward, the list filter
options.naming_maker: Partly: Filter, or sort: the list-filter sign.

cards.fewer_reason: A square spout and a wider funnel copied A too closely (0.997 and 0.938).

options.naming_maker: Names it: Play.
